nodes.name: Ghost: Post Published
nodes.notes:
Configure Ghost Admin > Integrations > Webhooks
URL: http://<YOUR_VM_IP>:5678/webhook/ghost-published
Event: Post published
Do the SAME for your second Ghost site.

nodes.name: Respond: Accepted
nodes.notes:
Immediately acknowledge the webhook so Ghost doesn't timeout.
The actual processing continues asynchronously below.

nodes.name: Should Process?
nodes.notes: Skip processing if post is not published (draft, scheduled, etc.)

nodes.name: Check TTS Service Health
nodes.notes: Verify TTS service is ready before proceeding.

nodes.name: Fetch Full Article (Ghost Content API)
nodes.notes:
Ghost Content API returns `plaintext` — pre-stripped clean text.
API keys are stored in n8n > Settings > Variables.
Create variables GHOST_KEY_SITE1 and GHOST_KEY_SITE2 in the n8n UI.

nodes.name: Convert to Narration Style (LLM)
nodes.notes:
Calls your vLLM instance to transform the article into spoken narration.
Temperature 0.3 keeps it faithful to the original.

nodes.name: Submit TTS Job
nodes.notes:
POSTs to the TTS service. Returns 202 + job_id immediately.
GCS path: audio/articles/{site}/{year}/{month}/{slug}.mp3

nodes.name: Wait (Initial)
nodes.notes:
Wait 2 minutes before first status check.
Wait nodes pass through their input data unchanged.

nodes.name: Check TTS Status
nodes.notes: Poll TTS service for job status. URL uses jobId from input data.

nodes.name: Evaluate Status & Context
nodes.notes:
Evaluates status and determines routing.
Uses time-based retry counting to work around n8n loop limitations.

nodes.name: Route by Status
nodes.notes:
Route based on route field from Evaluate node:
- completed → Success
- failed → Error logging
- timeout → Max retries exceeded
- default → Continue polling

nodes.name: Wait (Retry)
nodes.notes:
Wait 45 seconds between retries.
With maxRetries=30 and 2 min initial wait, allows ~25 minutes total.
Note: Data passed through is not used for context (we reference Prepare Polling Context directly).

nodes.name: TTS Callback (Optional)
nodes.notes:
ALTERNATIVE TO POLLING: Set N8N_CALLBACK_URL in TTS service.
This webhook receives job completion notifications.
Create a separate workflow for callback-based processing.

meta.description:
v3.1 - Ghost Article → Audio Pipeline

Converts Ghost blog posts to AI-narrated audio automatically.

Features:
- Immediate webhook response (202 Accepted)
- TTS health check before processing
- Skip non-published posts
- Time-based retry tracking (~25 min timeout)
- Switch-based status routing
- Structured GCS paths: audio/articles/{site}/{year}/{month}/{slug}.mp3
- Detailed logging

Polling Loop:
1. Prepare Polling Context stores all metadata at job submission
2. Wait (Initial) delays 2 minutes before first check
3. Check TTS Status polls the TTS service
4. Evaluate node uses time-based retry counting (references original context)
5. Route by Status determines: completed/failed/timeout/retry
6. Wait (Retry) delays 45 seconds before next poll

Environment Variables:
- TTS_SERVICE_URL: e.g., http://tts-service:8020
- VLLM_BASE_URL: e.g., http://vllm:8000
- VLLM_MODEL_NAME: Model name

n8n Variables (Settings > Variables):
- GHOST_KEY_SITE1: Ghost Content API key for site 1
- GHOST_KEY_SITE2: Ghost Content API key for site 2
